cause: The foreground command wrapper was terminated, but its child Python campaign process survived; a newly launched resumable worker then overlapped it.
corrective_action: Stopped all R1 Python workers, registered all overlap-window results as invalid, added a process-lifetime exclusive campaign lock, restored the cluster baseline, and restarted exactly one worker.
data_policy: Raw attempts remain append-only and are excluded by path from reuse and progress accounting.
